steps.action: Use a supported browser with an active internet connection.
Verify the homepage response, primary content, logo, call to action, layout, and absence of visible error headings.
steps.expected: The homepage is displayed successfully without a visible error or broken layout.

test_cases.title: Main navigation opens the correct pages

steps.action: Open the Emids homepage and verify the main navigation is available.
Open each main navigation group and select its identified destination.
Verify the resulting URL and page heading for Solutions, Capabilities, Industries, Insights, and Company.
steps.expected: Each navigation selection opens its corresponding page successfully.

test_cases.title: Primary call-to-action buttons open expected destinations

steps.action: Select the current primary Contact and Learn More equivalents: Connect and See How We Deliver Outcomes.
Verify each resulting URL and destination heading.
steps.expected: Each primary call to action opens the expected destination successfully.

test_cases.title: Website remains usable in mobile view

steps.action: Open the Emids homepage in a 390 by 844 mobile viewport.

steps.expected: Homepage text, logo, primary call to action, and mobile menu remain visible and usable without horizontal overflow.

steps.action: Select Connect from the mobile menu.
steps.expected: The mobile contact page opens successfully without horizontal page overflow.

test_cases.title: Contact form validates empty required fields

steps.action: Open the contact form and confirm all eight required fields are empty.
Verify the form remains open and inspect the validation state and associated message for every required field.
steps.expected: Every required field displays the clear message "This field is required." and the form is not submitted.
